discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: Topological insulators are a long-standing, heavily cited Nobel-calibre advance (Kane-Mele Z2 theory, 2005; Molenkamp's HgTe quantum well experiment, 2007) that has already won the Breakthrough, Dirac and Oliver E. Buckley prizes. They extend the topological-matter line the committee recognised in 2016, and with Shoucheng Zhang deceased the remaining theory-plus-experiment trio is clean. The 2025 prize honoured superconducting circuits rather than topological matter, so this field is still a strong candidate.
